post_run_measurement_correction.reason: Punctuation spacing manufactured a reference-letter S from possessive Ocean's on test397.
post_run_measurement_correction.algorithm: For bounded mentions only, canonicalize apostrophes, remove word-final possessive 's, join remaining word-internal apostrophes, then use the frozen boundary/numeric matcher. Preserve quoted 'S', S-shaped and entity possessives. Frozen exact-match and abstention rules are unchanged.
post_run_measurement_correction.reference_scope: Single historical canonical answer; bounded reference mentions remain string measures, not semantic/current-factual accuracy.

analysis_metadata.analysis: exploratory follow-up; statistics specified before main NQ generation
analysis_metadata.bootstrap_unit: whole qid, same resampling indices across policy and reference measures; conditional on this benchmark and model
analysis_metadata.mcnemar: exact two-sided binomial conditional on discordant bounded-target-mention pairs
analysis_metadata.holm_family: 18 none-versus-policy target-mention tests; adjusted separately from the PRIMARY3 fused-versus-ctx tests across poison/ignore/stealth; no rounding before adjustment
analysis_metadata.latency_accounting: seconds per unique result is its measured batch time divided by batch size; first-request attribution partitions real global execution cost and is not a policy-specific latency estimate; reused results are not additional executions
analysis_metadata.reference_scope: canonical historical single strings; exact/mention metrics do not establish semantic truth or current2026factuality
